title: Overlap and cross from the right
goal: A practitioner can read this play at a glance: Overlap and cross from the right.

rubric.must: The named scenario is visibly identified and its primary subject is clearly shown.
The picture visibly uses the required standard diagram structure and connected elements.
A reader can visually follow the principal flow or relationship from beginning to end.

items.evidence: “Overlap and cross from the right” is prominently titled, and the right-side overlap and cross are clearly depicted.
A standard soccer half-pitch, numbered player markers, ball, directional arrows, and a legend distinguishing pass, run, and dribble are visible.
The flow can be followed from player 7’s dribble, through the pass into player 2’s overlapping route, to the cross toward goal and the two runners.
Player labels 2, 7, 9, 10, and 11 are readable and remain attached to their respective markers.
Solid passes, dashed runs, and the wavy dribble are visually distinct; their arrowheads and shared handoff point communicate the intended sequence without implying an extra connection.
